Sūkṣmaviṣayatvaṃ cāliṅgaparyavasānam /I.45/
Sūkṣma-viṣayatvaṃ ca–aliṅga-paryavasānam /I.45/

 « Et l'objectivité subtile s'achève au [niveau] indifférencié [de la nature] »

Sūkṣmaviṣayatvaṃ cāliṅgaparyavasānam / Pārthivasya–aṇor gandha-tanmātraṃ
889
sūkṣmo viṣayaḥ / Āpyasya
890 rasa-tanmātram / Taijasasya rūpa-tanmātram / Vāyavīyasya
sparśa-tanmātram / Ākāśasya
891 śabda-tanmātram iti / Teṣām ahaṃkāraḥ / Asya–api liṅga-
mātraṃ
892 sūkṣmo viṣayaḥ
893 / Liṅga-mātrasya–apy aliṅgaṃ sūkṣmo viṣayaḥ / Na ca–aliṅgāt
paraṃ sūkṣmam asti / Nanv asti puruṣaḥ sūkṣma iti
894 / Satyam / Yathā liṅgāt param
aliṅ
